display.purpose: Rare — onboarding and empty-state headlines only.

title.purpose: Tile headers, card titles inside the booking cockpit.

mono.purpose: Fares, ETAs, distances, IDs — nowhere else.

shadows.name: elevation-1
shadows.purpose: Flat cards at rest, outside the cockpit.

shadows.name: elevation-3
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheets rising from the edge, outside the cockpit.

shadows.name: glass-shadow
shadows.purpose: Frosted tile interior highlight + drop, cockpit only.

shadows.name: brand-glow
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the active brand-gradient element itself (CTA, selected chip).

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Press/lift feedback and sheet entrance inside the booking cockpit — the one place overshoot is intentional.

components.name: Primary CTA (cockpit)
components.description: Full-width gradient booking CTA — the single highest-stakes button in the app.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; height:64px; border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0040E0,#2563EB,#4F46E5); color:#FAFAFA; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; border:none; box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,64,224,0.3); transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-cta:active { transform:scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #4A6FA5; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-cta:disabled { opacity:0.5; box-shadow:none; }

components.name: Secondary Button (flat, app-wide)
components.description: Default button outside the booking cockpit — no gradient, no glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; height:56px; border-radius:8px; background:#1A1A1A; color:#FAFAFA; font-weight:600; font-size:16px; border:none; transition:opacity 100ms, transform 100ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity:0.85; transform:scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity:0.4; }

components.name: Glass Tile
components.description: Frosted-glass tile — booking cockpit only, never used outside the booking flow.
components.css: .ds-glass-tile { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.62); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.65); border-radius:12px; padding:16px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.7), 0 2px 12px rgba(15,30,80,0.05); color:#1A1A1A; }

components.name: Flat Card (app-wide default)
components.description: Default card outside the booking cockpit — flat with a hairline border.
components.html:
Trip to Salt Lake
3 Jul, 6:40 PM
components.css: .ds-card { background:#FAFAFA; border:1px solid #E0E0DA; border-radius:12px; padding:16px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); color:#1A1A1A; }

components.name: Selectable Chip (trip type / car class / payment)
components.description: Unselected = neutral glass/flat; selected = brand-gradient fill with inverse text and glow, driven by a shared spring-animated indicator.
components.css: .ds-chip { border-radius:999px; padding:8px 16px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; border:none; cursor:pointer; color:#60605B; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.62); transition:all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-chip:hover { color:#1A1A1A; } .ds-chip-active { color:#FAFAFA; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0040E0,#4F46E5); box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,64,224,0.3); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input — flat canvas variant. Cockpit variant swaps background for glass.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; height:48px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #E0E0DA; background:#F4F4F1; color:#1A1A1A; font-size:16px; padding:0 16px; outline:none; transition:border-color 100ms; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#4A6FA5; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(74,111,165,0.3); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#60605B; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar (tubelight nav)
components.description: Floating frosted pill nav; active tab gets a brand-blue glow indicator (never charcoal — a charcoal blur reads as a smudge, not a glow).
components.html: HomeTripsWalletAccount
components.css: .ds-navbar { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; background:rgba(250,250,250,0.9); border:1px solid rgba(224,224,218,0.7); backdrop-filter:blur(24px); border-radius:999px; padding:8px 12px; box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); } .ds-navbar-tab { flex:1; text-align:center; padding:10px 0; border-radius:999px; color:#60605B; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; } .ds-navbar-tab-active { color:#1A1A1A; font-weight:600; box-shadow: inset 0 12px 12px -8px rgba(0,64,224,0.3); }

narrative.overview: Vahnly's booking surface is a premium car-owner control panel floating over the map — the road stays visible beneath a layer of frosted glass, and the one action that matters (book the driver) is the only element that fully commits to color: a deep blue-to-indigo gradient (#0040E0 → #2563EB → #4F46E5) that reads instantly against the restrained warm-neutral canvas underneath. Everywhere else — trip history, account, settings — the shell stays flat, charcoal-inked, and quiet. The glass and the gradient are earned real estate, reserved for the moment the rider is actively commanding a trip; they are not a default skin applied to the whole product. This system explicitly rejects glassmorphism as ambient decoration scattered across every screen, gradient text, all-caps display type, and any brand color beyond the three defined roles.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white canvas (#FAFAFA) and charcoal ink (#1A1A1A) as the base, everywhere.
Frosted glass (tile, panel, sheet) exclusively on the booking cockpit over the map.
One brand gradient, reserved for the primary CTA and active-state indicators only.
Steel-blue as the separate, calmer accent for links, focus rings, and informational borders.
Mono type (JetBrains Mono) exclusively for fares, ETAs, distances, and IDs.

rules.name: The Inverse-Text Rule
rules.body: Any element painted with the brand gradient MUST set its text color via the content-inverse token (#FAFAFA), verified against 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Rare Gradient Rule
rules.body: The brand gradient appears in exactly two places: the primary CTA and the active-state indicator for a selectable chip/tile/tab.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any figure the rider is trusting financially or temporally renders in --font-mono; prose about the number stays in Inter.

rules.name: The Cockpit-Only Glass Rule
rules.body: .glass-tile / .glass-panel / .glass-sheet render only inside the booking flow. A settings row or trip-history card reaching for glass is reaching for the wrong material.

dos: Do reserve the brand gradient for exactly two roles: the primary CTA and active-state indicators.
Do map every inverse-text use through --color-content-inverse and verify 4.5:1 before shipping.
Do keep frosted glass scoped to the booking cockpit only; flat + hairline everywhere else.
Do render fares, ETAs, distances, and IDs in --font-mono; everything else in Inter.
Do collapse rare-use controls behind progressive disclosure instead of permanent equal weight.
donts: Don't apply glassmorphism outside the booking cockpit.
Don't hardcode brand-gradient hex values in component JSX — always reference the CSS variable.
Don't ship a gradient-backed element with unmapped or assumed-inverse text.
Don't run more than one infinite decorative motion loop competing for attention on a single screen.
Don't use all-caps display headlines, or introduce a brand color outside the three defined roles.
